STUDY 174
Pink Button-Up & Rimless Glasses at Night
Rights check
Source: 25065.jpg
Sleek, candid, urban
WORKING NOTES
- The fitted pink shirt and rimless glasses are the defining
details.
- Keep the warm storefront glow for a nighttime city
atmosphere.
Try this: Keep the warm storefront glow for a nighttime

IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
straight dark hair and rimless glasses
stands on a city street at night. She
wears a fitted pink button-up shirt with a
cinched waist, open at the neckline over
a black bralette, and a black shoulder
bag strap across her body. Dark low-rise
denim jeans complete the look. Her
expression is calm and direct. Warm
streetlight and a glowing storefront
behind her. Palette of blush pink, deep
navy, and warm amber. Sleek and
candid, in the style of a night street-style
photo.
